context: Tests whether the agent correctly implements the rss-curation post-digest workflow: using search with the required --limit flag, resolving numbered IDs to URLs before submitting feedback, using the --signal flag with +1/-1 values, treating stars as independent of feedback, invoking learn with both required flags, and noting the ~20-signal threshold recommendation.

checklist.name: Search subcommand used
checklist.description: Script calls `node rss-feed.mjs search` (not a generic grep or curl)

checklist.name: Feedback subcommand used
checklist.description: Script calls `node rss-feed.mjs feedback` at least once

checklist.name: --signal flag with +1 or -1
checklist.description: Feedback invocation uses `--signal +1` or `--signal -1` (not emoji, not --up/--down as a flag name)

checklist.name: ID-to-URL resolution step
checklist.description: Script includes a step (comment, variable assignment, or echo) that explicitly resolves a numbered result position to its URL before calling feedback --url

checklist.name: Positive and negative feedback
checklist.description: Script submits both a +1 signal and a -1 signal (two separate feedback calls or clear placeholders for each)

checklist.name: Star subcommand used
checklist.description: Script calls `node rss-feed.mjs star` (not unstar or starred — the bookmark action itself)

checklist.name: Star is separate from feedback
checklist.description: The star command is a distinct call from the feedback command — the article is both starred AND given +1 feedback (both commands present, not one instead of the other)

checklist.name: Learn --db and --profile flags
checklist.description: The learn invocation includes both `--db` and `--profile` flags

checklist.name: ~20-signal threshold noted
checklist.description: Script contains a comment or echo statement recommending running learn after approximately 20 (or 20+) feedback signals
